_comment: Every command-line AI tool that deadreckon counts tokens for.
This is an authored file: edit it by hand to add or remove CLIs.
If this file does not exist, the system falls back to a built-in list
hardcoded in sessions.py, so deleting it is always safe.
name              display name shown in reports
paths             home-relative paths that prove the tool is installed
binary            command name checked with `which`, null if none
reader            key into sessions.READERS that counts this tool's tokens,
null if no reader exists yet
store_labels      canonical stores.BY_LABEL entries read by reader; [] if none
no_tokens_because why this tool cannot be token-counted, null if it CAN be

clis.name: Jules CLI
clis.no_tokens_because: cloud agent — work runs on Google's servers, no local token record

clis.name: grok-cli (@vibe-kit)
clis.no_tokens_because: records no usage of any kind
